_readme: Settings for the group events page (/events/: schools, churches, companies, festivals). Built by towns/build.js into ers-embed/events.html. Units are referenced by their slug in towns/inventory.json; prices, outlets and attendants come from there.

page.title: School Field Day, Festival & Company Picnic Inflatable Rentals | Bounce Buddies
page.description: Inflatable rentals for school field days, church festivals, company picnics and community events in Cincinnati & Northern Kentucky. $1M insured. Request a quote.

_quote: Where quote requests go. The form never sends anything by itself: it builds the request, then offers 'Copy & open contact form' (contactUrl), 'Email it' (only shown if email is set) and 'Call'.
_offers: Set each to "yes" once you've confirmed you offer it; "ask" shows softer 'ask us' wording. nonprofitDiscount: leave "" for none, or write the offer, e.g. "10% off for schools and nonprofits".
